jurisdiction_name: NFLD VILL WARD D (NORTHFIELD VILLAGE Village)
narrative: Nfld Vill Ward D (Village of Northfield Village) has 602 registered voters, with 61.3% unaffiliated or lacking primary history. Republican-leaning voters make up 15.9% of registrants and Democratic-leaning voters account for 22.8%, a clear Democratic lean of 6.8 percentage points.
